Come AGsplore with Us! Check out our videos to learn more about where your food comes from and what careers are available in the wide and wonderful field of agriculture.

AGSPLORATION is an agriculture literacy program for youth, developed and coordinated by University of Maryland Extension. The basis of AGsploration is a 24-lesson curriculum designed to connect kids with where their food comes from while simultaneously bolstering skills in science, technology, engineering, and math. The curriculum is free and available for anyone to download via our website!

Visit our website at www.extension.umd.edu/agsploration.
